claims.citation: New York Herald, 21 June 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Bark "Ceder" (Brem), Rohlfs, Bremen, 31 days, with
mdse and 240 passengers, to Ruger Bros. Had one death on
the passage. While crossing the bar at Sandy Hook, in tow
of steamer Seth Low, the hawser parted, throwing over-
board the mate and two seamen[?]; one of the latter—Joseph
Alfs, of Fayal—was drowned, the other, with the mate, was
rescued.
